title: Velocity Ultra
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#493, 2026-10-15), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.16, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal environment, DXVK async on, AVX advertised, Metal HUD, recipes steam, controller-sdl, corefonts, dotnet48, vcrun2022, bloody-spell and xact, rated 2 of 5: the pre-launcher shows, the main window opens about one time in twenty, and the ship then moves very slowly. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Launches, not playable. The game's pre-launcher (settings.exe, 32-bit) shows, and Play rarely brings the main window. The launch log has DXVK's 'Failed to create surface' twice and a stack overflow in settings.exe. A Direct3D 9 game, so in the D3DMetal and DXMT modes it goes through DXVK's Direct3D 9 on the default engine; With Wine's own Direct3D as the game's mode the pre-launcher crashes outright (0xc0000409, a fail-fast in settings.exe, before game.exe starts; highball-db#493, 2026-10-19, engine r28), so that mode is worse. ProtonDB has it working with GE-Proton on Linux.

knownIssues.symptom: The main window rarely opens after the pre-launcher's Play, and when it does the ship moves very slowly
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; the log shows DXVK failing to create its presentation surface and a stack overflow in the pre-launcher
knownIssues.fix: none known. Wine's own Direct3D makes the pre-launcher crash (2026-10-19). Untested: starting game.exe directly, without settings.exe

knownIssues.symptom: game.exe exits about two seconds in, or stops itself with a fatal error (0xc0000409), right after creating its Direct3D 9 device, on DXVK ('Failed to create surface') and on Wine's own Direct3D ('failed to set pixel format') alike (reported on an M1, engine r28, highball-db#493, 2026-10-21 and 23)
knownIssues.cause: both graphics paths fail at the same step, attaching the picture to the game's window, so it is how Wine's Mac driver handles that window at that moment rather than the graphics mode. It depends on timing, since the game starts once in a while
knownIssues.fix: none known. Needs work in Wine's Mac driver
